jobs.title: Growth Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
**About Dizplai**

At Dizplai, we transform passive audiences into active communities that drive culture, conversation, and commerce. We partner with Premier League clubs, global motorsport organisations, Olympic sports federations, leading broadcasters, and multi-million subscriber creator networks across sports and entertainment, helping them turn attention into lasting commercial value.

By combining creative consultancy, interactive technology, and data-driven insights, we help unlock the full commercial potential of audiences. We're at the forefront of the shift where platforms are the new networks, creators are the new media companies, and fans want to belong, not just watch.

**About the Role**

Dizplai is looking for a Growth Marketing Manager to build and run our marketing engine, driving consistent activity that generates qualified leads, starts new conversations and helps the sales team win business.

Working within the commercial team, you’ll partner closely with our Content Marketing Manager to shape our marketing strategy. They’ll lead content development, while you’ll build and run campaigns that use our services, client work and expertise to give the right people a clear reason to engage. You’ll plan the activity, coordinate the people involved, keep campaigns moving week to week and measure what’s working.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Sales alignment and lead generation:** Build marketing activity around sales priorities, target accounts and sectors. Create campaigns that help secure meetings, develop opportunities and re-engage prospects.
* **Website:** Keep the website current, clearly communicate our services and showcase client results. Improve landing pages, calls to action and enquiry journeys to turn relevant traffic into leads.
* **Content and distribution:** Coordinate case studies, thought leadership, product updates and sales content. Build a distribution plan for each piece across email, social, partners and direct sales outreach.
* **Social:** Support a consistent LinkedIn programme across the business and key team members, using client stories, expertise and industry conversations to reach prospective customers.
* **CRM and nurturing:** Own the marketing use of HubSpot, including segmentation, lead capture, nurture journeys and handover to sales. Ensure campaign and event contacts receive timely, relevant follow-up.
* **Newsletters and email:** Build regular communications for prospects, customers and partners, alongside targeted campaigns that create reasons to book a conversation or revisit an opportunity.
* **Sales support:** Equip the team with current decks, case studies, service summaries and follow-up materials that answer buyer questions and help opportunities progress.
* **Owned and trade events:** Build an annual calendar covering our own roundtables, webinars and customer events, alongside relevant conferences and trade shows. Own promotion, invitations, meeting generation and follow-up.

**Success Metrics**  
Your performance will be measured by outcomes including:

* **Qualified leads** generated
* **Meetings** secured and pipeline influenced
* **Opportunities created** and overall contribution to pipeline
* **Website conversion** performance and improvements
* **Email engagement** and campaign performance (e.g., CTR, conversion, progression rates)

**Desired Experience**

* Strong hands-on experience running multi-channel campaigns with measurable results
* Proven ability to translate sales priorities into marketing plans and assets
* Confidence using HubSpot (or a similar CRM/marketing platform) to manage capture, nurturing, and handover
* Proven ability to manage content, distribution, and execution across multiple stakeholders
* A structured, proactive approach—able to plan activity, maintain momentum, and coordinate delivery every week

If you enjoy owning the details, driving execution, and partnering closely with sales to deliver measurable commercial growth, then you’re ready to build our marketing engine.

**Our Hiring Process**

We believe in a transparent process designed to put you at ease so you can show us your best work. Here is how we get to know each other:

* **Mutual Fit Chat -** A conversation to ensure our expectations align. This is a two-way introduction to the role, the company’s direction, and what you’re looking for in your next career move.
* **Manager Deep Dive -** A focused session with your potential lead. We’ll explore your experience, your technical approach, and how you tackle the types of challenges we face daily.
* **F2F Practical Exercise & Culture Peer Session -** An in-person visit to our office where you’ll work through a real-world task. This is followed by a session with your potential peers focused purely on cultural alignment, ensuring our values and working styles mesh.
* **Next Steps -** Following these stages, we aim to provide clear, honest feedback. In some cases, if specific questions arise from the peer session, we may invite you for a final follow-up to ensure we’ve covered everything before making a decision.

**Our Values**

These values guide how we act day to day, who we recruit, and how we all hold ourselves accountable.

* **Boundless** — Think bigger. Innovate beyond the obvious.
* **Purposeful Impact** — Focus on meaningful results, not effort.
* **Collective Strength** — Support each other, challenge each other, grow together.
* **Positive Balance** — Work with intensity *and* sustainability.

We're a team that is deeply customer-obsessed, plays to win, and isn't afraid to take big, bold bets. We move fast, hold a high bar, and are committed to growing together as we scale.

==================

Stacks is hiring our first Content Lead: a sharp, curious writer who can take a complex product and turn it into stories finance leaders want to read.

You'll set the campaign themes for the year and turn our product messaging into content and campaigns that get finance leaders' attention and make Stacks the recognised leader in the space. Those themes shape our events, customer stories, podcast episodes and ads, so prospects hear one consistent message.

jobs.description:
**About Curate Group**

Curate Group is a dynamic events and experiences company, creating unforgettable moments that bring people together. We specialise in unique, high-quality live events - from large scale festivals, immersive concerts, cultural experiences and corporate events partnering with some of the world's most exciting brands.

Our mission is to bring people together for fun, connection and moments that last. As a growing business, we value curiosity, collaboration and a people-first approach, giving our team the freedom and support to innovate and thrive.

We're launching partnerships with new brands and we're looking for a creative, hands-on marketer to own the social media and marketing from the start.

This is a great opportunity to help launch and grow a brand, with real ownership of your channels and campaigns and the chance to see the direct impact of your work on ticket sales and audience growth.

If you're a confident, self-starting marketer who loves social media, thrives on variety and wants to build something new, this role would be a great fit for you.

**Location:** London

**Work Pattern:** Hybrid (3 days in office, 2 days working from home)

**THE ROLE**

You'll be responsible for the social media and day-to-day marketing of our new brands, working as a strong individual contributor in the Brands team alongside our other Social Media & Marketing Managers. You'll work closely with the wider marketing and paid media teams, our partners and our events teams to deliver campaigns that build the brand and sell tickets. The role is initially a 6-month fixed-term contract, with the opportunity to become permanent based on the success of the launch.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Social Media**

* Own the brand's organic social media channels, including planning, creating and scheduling content
* Develop a content calendar aligned to launches, events and key moments
* Create engaging, on-brand content, including short-form video, stories and posts, and capture content at events where needed
* Build and engage the brand's online community, responding to comments and messages
* Stay on top of social trends and platform changes, and test new formats and ideas

**AI & Content Innovation**

* Use AI tools (such as ChatGPT, Claude, Canva and CapCut's AI features) to create and edit content, including copy, captions, images and short-form video
* Build AI into your day-to-day workflow to produce content faster and at volume, without compromising on quality or the brand's tone of voice
* Use AI to generate and test new ideas for campaigns, content formats, hooks and audience angles
* Review all AI-assisted content for accuracy, brand fit and usage rights before it goes live
* Keep up to date with new AI tools and share what works with the wider Brands team

**Campaigns & Launches**

* Plan and deliver social and marketing campaigns for launches, new events and seasonal moments
* Work with the paid media team to brief creative and make sure paid and organic activity work together
* Coordinate marketing activity with the new brands, including joint content and approvals

**General Marketing**

* Deliver day-to-day marketing across channels, including email, website and event listings
* Write clear, engaging copy that reflects the brand's tone of voice
* Brief and work with external partners, such as creators, photographers and influencers
* Help maintain brand guidelines and make sure all content is consistent and high quality

**Performance & Insights**

* Track and report on social and campaign performance, including reach, engagement, audience growth and ticket sales
* Use data and audience insight to improve content and campaigns
* Share learnings with the wider team

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

* Experience in a social media or marketing role, ideally managing brand channels independently
* Strong content creation skills, including short-form video and copywriting
* Hands-on experience using AI tools to create content, speed up production and generate new ideas, with examples you can share
* A good eye for design and brand consistency
* Confident using social media scheduling and analytics tools
* Experience running campaigns from planning through to reporting
* Experience with email marketing is a plus
* Background in live events, entertainment or consumer-facing brands is a strong plus
* Highly proactive and organised: you plan ahead, manage your own workload and don't wait to be asked
* Creative and curious, with high standards and a passion for quality
* Comfortable working flexibly, including occasional evening or weekend events

**WHAT WE OFFER**

* A competitive salary, depending on experience
* 28 days' annual leave a year, including bank and other public holidays (pro rata for the length of the contract)
* Additional annual leave days around Christmas and New Year
* Your birthday off (or a day of your choice that month if it falls on a weekend)
* A flexible hybrid-working policy, with offices in London (currently in Holborn and moving to Battersea Power Station in 2027)
* Employee pension
* Significant opportunities for personal growth and career progression as the business scales
* Complimentary access to our full range of events and concerts for family and friends

Join Harris Federation and play a key role in shaping how our primary academies present themselves online as our Website Content and Communications Manager.

This is an exciting opportunity for a talented communications professional to lead the migration of academy websites to a new Federation-wide platform, creating engaging, accessible and audience-focused content that brings each school's unique story to life. Working closely with academy leaders and stakeholders, you will help showcase the achievements, values and opportunities that make our schools distinctive while supporting pupil recruitment and community engagement.

This role is offered as a 12-month fixed-term contract.

The founder and sponsor of the Harris Federation, Lord Harris of Peckham, opened our first school in 1990. We have, over the past thirty years, implemented ideas and initiatives that have transformed the opportunities of pupils from working class and disadvantaged backgrounds. Harris academies are widely recognised as a force for social mobility. We now have over 50 schools educating more than 40,000 young people across London and Essex, and employ over 5,000 staff across our academies and head office. With the majority of our academies located in areas of high socioeconomic disadvantage, a high-quality education is key to the futures of the pupils we serve.

As a provider of employment and education, we value the diversity of our staff and students, and all our staff are equally valued and respected. We are committed to providing a fair, equitable and mutually supportive learning and working environment for our students and staff.
